task_name: World 116 Task B  -  QC Server Archive Hygiene, Partial-Temp & IFU Exclusion, and Lot-Locator Governance
prompt: Perform a comprehensive Accounting & CFO Close review using the world files (`cmo_lhr_invoicing_and_qc_archive_audit_2026.xlsx`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.

rubric.description: Audits the 11,044-file QC server index into 4,433 primary Work Order packets (40.14%) and 2,153 Receiving Inspection / Sub-Lot Material packets (19.49%), totaling 6,586 core manufacturing evidence packets.

Identifies and excludes 1,161 non-LHR noise files across the QC server: 590 partial rsync temp files (.part.) and 571 Instructions-for-Use (IFU) product insert PDFs (10.51% combined noise rate across the 11,044 files).

Quantifies the 431 special-routing lot packets across the archive: 286 alpha-prefixed Bosstent lots (C-shape), 120 OQ/PQ/First-Article validation lots, and 25 Rework/Planned Deviation companion packets.

Enforces fail-closed lot-locator hygiene: exclude .part. temp files so valid lots do not fail with false-positive duplicate ambiguity, block IFU inserts from invoice attachments, restrict year-folder pruning to 20xx so 4-digit part folders (3001) are never skipped, and require human review when a Rework/PD packet is present.
